audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Volibear rows 1-5 and Skill at 2+ items. The already-audited mirror (ksante__volibear) settled the chart as Skill / Skill / K'Sante / K'Sante / Skill / Skill / Volibear, and the old row 6 also contradicted its own phases[6].why, which calls Volibear a drain-tank K'Sante cannot burst.
audit.why: Path Maker's knockback stun and Footwork's shield break the Volibear commit through levels 3-5; the lane evens out at 6 and first item; All Out costs K'Sante his own defenses, which is where Volibear's health and on-hit bite take over.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-6 set to Skill / K'Sante / K'Sante / Skill / Skill / Volibear on both layers, ratings realigned.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as Volibear's strongest window with no mention of All Out's 120s cooldown or its wall-launch, and the first-item row claimed Volibear forces the fight.
audit.why: Stormbringer is 160s at rank 1, grants bonus health (not a shield) and disables towers near the landing point. All Out is 120/100/80s, knocks the target back through walls, heals him and raises his damage at the cost of reduced defenses.
audit.corrected: phases[4..5].why now carry those numbers and the reduced-defense trade-off.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly attributed the knockback to K'Sante's Q ('Dodge his Q knockups', 'Get walled by his Q'). Riot's text puts the knockback and stun on Path Maker (W) and the wall-launch on All Out (R); Ntofo Strikes (Q) is a 3.5s line strike that slows and, at 2 stacks, pulls enemies in. Volibear's Sky Splitter was also treated as engage rather than a slow-and-self-shield.
audit.why: A player told to dodge 'his Q knockup' will space against the wrong ability and eat the actual one. It also matters which stun disappears: while All Out, Path Maker no longer knocks back or stuns.
audit.corrected: W is the knockback stun (14s at rank 1); Q pulls at 2 stacks on 3.5s; R launches through walls; All Out removes W's stun and reduces his defenses.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named All Out as the tracked cooldown with no number and no sequence.
audit.why: The cooldown that decides laning is Path Maker at 14s, not a 120s ultimate; Footwork at 8-10s is the second gate.
audit.corrected: Path Maker written with its cooldown and the All Out exception; Footwork's cooldown added to the phase text.

edits.before: Dodge his Q knockups — all-in when his R is down. Volibear wins by trading around K'Sante's All Out and cashing the pattern: all-in on his R cooldown.
edits.after: The knockback is Path Maker (W), not his Q — Ntofo Strikes pulls you in at two stacks. Fight after he spends W; All Out strips his defenses and removes that stun.

edits.before: - K'Sante All Out: matchup-defining — His duelist mode. All-in when it’s down. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Path Maker (W): 14s at rank 1 — the knockback stun that ends your commit. All Out removes the stun, so fight him in it.

edits.before: His duelist mode. All-in when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: All Out shreds his own defenses — his Path Maker stun is gone while it is up.

edits.before: Dodge his Q wall-knockups
edits.after: Dodge Path Maker knockback

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: All Out heals him and boosts his damage — never start it below half health.

edits.before: Q + W online — stun in, double-bite out. K'Sante has to respect every walk-up once your second W heal-bite threatens.
edits.after: Q + W online, but Ntofo Strikes is a 3.5s poke and pulls you in at two stacks — trade only after he spends the second.

edits.before: E completes the pattern: shield yourself as you disengage or slow K'Sante under the sky-splitter. This is the start of your kill window.
edits.after: Sky Splitter slows and shields you in the blast, but it is not a stun — Path Maker knocks you back out of the fight before the bite lands.

edits.before: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard. Run K'Sante down every time All Out is on cooldown — you win the stat-check from here to 6.
edits.after: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard, but Footwork (8-10s) shields the burst and Path Maker resets the spacing — chip, do not commit.

edits.before: Stormbringer online — you can dive K'Sante under tower with the disable. The 3-6 window is the strongest your lane will ever be: cash it.
edits.after: Stormbringer disables his tower and gives bonus health, but All Out (120s) drags you out through a wall — whoever commits second wins.

edits.before: Sundered Sky doubles down on the all-in: crit-heal on the first hit of every fight. Force K'Sante to fight or lose the wave.
edits.after: Sundered Sky heals on the first hit, but his tank items match it — even window, so trade on his Footwork cooldown only.

edits.before: You win level 1 outright — Q stun and W heal beat his weak unstacked passive.
edits.after: Level 1 is close — your Q stun trades with his 3.5s Ntofo Strikes chip.

edits.before: Level 2 stays yours as W's sustain wins the short trades before he has W Path Maker.
edits.after: Level 2 is even: your Maul sustain against his Ntofo Strikes pull at two stacks.

edits.before: Level 3 favours you: full Q-W-E lets you all-in while his passive is still slow.
edits.after: Level 3 is his: Path Maker (14s) knocks back and stuns your whole commit.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 remain yours since he lacks the items to survive your extended trades.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 favour him — Footwork shields every trade on an 8-10s cooldown.

edits.before: At 2+ items K'Sante's damage reduction and armor let him out-sustain and reposition you.
edits.after: At 2+ items your health, on-hit bite and Stormbringer out-last his shredded defenses.

notes: The packet's suspect name "Frenzied Maul's" in the early field is a FALSE POSITIVE — it is the real ability name in possessive form. I followed the mirror's chart (Skill/Skill/K'Sante/K'Sante/Skill/Skill/Volibear) over the packet chart, which had Volibear winning rows 0-4 and losing 2+ items; the two disagree in every row and the mirror is the audited side. Removed no 'unstoppable' claim because none was present here, but note Riot's W text gives only reduced damage during the charge — do not let 'W block' language in dontsFull[2].t grow into an unstoppable claim. Volibear's E carries a 'projectile' derived flag that contradicts Riot's own text; no Wind Wall claim written.
